import toolz

# R2 tests
f = toolz.compose_left(lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
print('compose_left(5):', f(5))  # Should be (5+1)*2 = 12

g = toolz.compose(lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
print('compose(5):', g(5))  # Should be (x+1) after (x*2), so 5 -> 10 -> 11

h = toolz.pipe(5, lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
print('pipe(5):', h(5))  # Should be 5 -> 6 -> 12
"
